actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: No resident contributed over 30 units in the last round and wallet (9.1) is below the free‑rider threshold, so I cannot contribute; I rest and broadcast a reminder.

message.reasoning:

So rule: if any contributed >30 in most recent round, punish. None, so else if wallet > free_rider_threshold (10) contribute 1. Wallet is 9.1, below 10, cannot contribute. So must rest. Also broadcast short message discouraging large contributions. So do rest and broadcast.
